_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-03 (pilot batch S7). Current gen = Stokke Xplory X (Clek lists 'Xplory'). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Stokke Xplory X

clekListed.clekRow: Stokke Xplory — Stokke Stroller car seat adapter Multi (321500)

specs._weightNote: 13.4 kg / 29.5 lb (Strollberry official). One retailer lists 26.5 lb — reconfirm on stokke.com.
specs._dimsNote: Open 131 × 56 × 101 cm (H×W×L); folded frame-only 105 × 56 × 47.5 cm (H×W×L). Tall pram-height seat.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (seat reclines flat / bassinet-style) to ~4 yr

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (required for US sale)
safety.certifications: not published on the product page (JPMA not stated)

recall.note: No recall applies to the current Xplory X. An earlier-generation Stokke Xplory (units sold Sept 2003-Dec 2006, grey handles, serials 1-27,295 & 27,698-28,097) was recalled in Dec 2007 for a front-wheel bolt that could loosen and detach (CPSC): https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2007/stokke-announces-recall-of-certain-xplory-strollers-due-to-front-wheel-detachment . That recall does not cover the current Xplory X generation.

safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible height-adjustable seat; parking brake.

specs.foldType: one-step or two-piece fold; NOT compact/travel-class
specs.tires: rubber-coated; front 18 cm swivel-lockable, rear 23 cm

notes: Full-size luxury pram — high seat, reversible, lie-flat — NOT a portability pick (~29.5 lb, bulky fold); included for roster completeness, will score low on the portability lens. Clek Liing attaches via the Stokke Multi adapter 321500 (adapter-321500), which explicitly lists Clek Liing. Best cited price $719.40 sale (Mega Babies, sold out); MSRP ~$1,199. Reconfirm current in-stock price at stokke.com / Nordstrom.
